# InstanceManager

> **File:** `services/InstanceManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Keeps one axiom per display. At start (and again 5 s later, for one started in the same moment) lists this install's instances on this display (`qs list`); the newest (ShellInstances) ends the others and an older one quits. Two can start when the restart bind fires twice, or is pressed again while axiom starts: `qs kill` ends only one of them (scripts/restart.sh, which every restart bind runs now, ends them all). Not in the greeter. Created from shell.qml's `_services`.

### Functions

- `check()`
